The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fishery of the Republic of Croatia () is a ministry of the Croatian government, whose work is aimed at overseeing the development of agriculture and fisheries in Croatia.
, the Neretva Delta in Dalmatia makes a major contribution in some sectors.]]
